title: Exhibit I: negative of sketch of 8-ft silver canopy with dark cable and canister below
description: White-on-black negative photostat headed and footed "EXHIBIT I" with struck-through CONFIDENTIAL stamps. A line sketch shows a shallow domed canopy dimensioned "8'" and labeled "SILVER", joined by a slanted "DARK CABLE" (marked about 5') to a rectangular body labeled "BALL OR A CANISTER" and "SILVER". The overall form resembles a parachute suspending a canister.
